title: Implement byte instruction variants
description: Most instructions need byte variants (MOVB, CMPB, BITB, BICB, BISB, CLRB, INCB, DECB, etc.). Currently only TSTB is implemented. Byte operations are essential for string processing and character I/O.

title: Implement core branch instructions
description: Missing branch instructions: BR, BNE, BEQ, BMI, BGE, BLT, BGT, BLE, BVC, BVS, BCC, BCS. Currently only BPL is implemented. Each branch tests appropriate PSW flags and modifies PC by signed offset if condition met.

title: Implement KW11-L line time clock
description:
Implement the KW11-L line time clock peripheral for timing and periodic interrupts.

**Registers:**
- LKS (0o177546): Line Clock Status Register

**Key features:**
- 60 Hz (or 50 Hz) periodic interrupt capability
- Essential for time-based operations and task scheduling
- Simple register at 0o177546

**Implementation approach:**
- Memory-mapped register
- Can initially just set ready bit
- Full interrupt support can be added later when interrupt system is implemented

**Priority:** Lower than console I/O but important for running Unix and other time-dependent software.

title: Implement TM11 magnetic tape controller
description: Implement TM11 magnetic tape controller for tape I/O operations. Lower priority than console and disk but useful for backup and data transfer operations. Registers at 0o172520-0o172532.

title: Implement interrupt system
description: Implement the PDP-11 interrupt system for peripheral interrupts. Includes interrupt priority levels, vector handling, PSW management, stack operations for PC/PSW save/restore, and RTI instruction. Required for DL11, KW11-L, and RK11 interrupt support.

title: Implement memory-mapped I/O framework
description: Create infrastructure for memory-mapped I/O to support peripherals. Currently RK11 registers are in RAM but need proper MMIO handling. Requires checking address ranges for I/O space (typically 0o160000-0o177777) and routing reads/writes to appropriate peripheral controllers instead of RAM.

title: Implement core single operand instructions
description: Implement missing single operand instructions: COM (complement), INC (increment), DEC (decrement), NEG (negate), ADC (add carry), SBC (subtract carry), ROR/ROL (rotate), ASR (arithmetic shift right).

title: Implement ADD and SUB arithmetic instructions
description: Implement ADD (060000-067777) and SUB (160000-167777) double operand arithmetic instructions. These are essential for mathematical operations in PDP-11 programs.

title: Implement Add trait for Word
description: Currently Word type has AddAssign, SubAssign, Sub, and BitAnd implementations, but is missing the Add trait. This makes it impossible to use the + operator for addition (only += works). Implement ops::Add for Word to enable ergonomic arithmetic: let result = word1 + word2. This follows Rust conventions where types implementing AddAssign should also implement Add.

title: Implement DL11/KL11 console serial interface
description:
Implement console serial I/O for the PDP-11 emulator. This is the most critical peripheral for user interaction.

**Registers (at 0o177560-0o177567):**
- RCSR (0o177560): Receiver Control/Status Register
- RBUF (0o177562): Receiver Buffer (read-only)
- XCSR (0o177564): Transmitter Control/Status Register
- XBUF (0o177566): Transmitter Buffer (write-only)

**Key features:**
- Character input from stdin
- Character output to stdout
- Ready bits to indicate when device can accept/provide data
- Interrupt support (can defer for now)

**Implementation approach:**
- Memory-mapped I/O at standard addresses
- Polling mode initially (no interrupts)
- Simple stdin/stdout for console I/O

Without this, programs cannot perform basic I/O operations.

title: Implement PSW flag manipulation instructions
description: Implement PSW flag manipulation instructions: CLC/SEC (carry), CLV/SEV (overflow), CLZ/SEZ (zero), CLN/SEN (negative), CCC/SCC (all flags), NOP (no operation).

title: Implement Index addressing modes
description:
Currently Index and IndexDeferred addressing modes are not implemented (marked with todo!()). These are essential for PDP-11 programs that use indexed addressing.

**Missing implementations:**
- Index addressing mode (mode 6): X(Rn) 
- IndexDeferred addressing mode (mode 7): @X(Rn)

**Files to update:**
- src/cpu/impls.rs (4 locations each in word, word_mut, byte, byte_mut methods)

**Implementation details:**
- Index mode: Add index offset to register value to get final address
- IndexDeferred mode: Add index offset to register value, then dereference to get final address
- Index offset comes from the next word in instruction stream

**Acceptance criteria:**
- All todo!() calls for Index/IndexDeferred are replaced with working implementations
- Tests pass with indexed addressing mode instructions
- Emulator can execute programs using indexed addressing

title: Implement MMU for memory management
description: Implement Memory Management Unit (MMU) with address translation for running larger programs and operating systems like Unix. Includes separate I/D spaces, relocation registers, and protection. Required for running Unix V6/V7. Registers at 0o177600-0o177776.

title: Complete JMP instruction implementation
description: JMP instruction is currently marked as todo!(). Need to implement unconditional jump that sets PC to the effective address of the operand. Should work with all addressing modes.

title: Implement BIC and BIS bit manipulation instructions
description: Implement BIC (040000-047777) Bit Clear and BIS (050000-057777) Bit Set double operand instructions. These are commonly used for bit field manipulation.

title: Implement JSR/RTS subroutine instructions
description: Implement JSR (004000-004777) Jump to Subroutine and RTS (000200-000207) Return from Subroutine instructions. Essential for function calls and stack management.

title: Convert repo to workspace
description: Convert this repo to cargo workspace to make it easier to split the codebase into multiple crates (i.e. separate lib and bin crates)

title: Analyze missing features
description:
- Analyze code to understand what features are missing
- Enumerate missing features and create ticket tracking their implementation

title: Remove test_ prefix from test function names
Implement core branch instructions
description: Missing branch instructions: BR, BNE, BEQ, BMI, BGE, BLT, BGT, BLE, BVC, BVS, BCC, BCS. Currently only BPL is implemented.

title: Fix PSW flag calculations in existing instructions
description: Several instructions have incomplete PSW flag calculations: CMP missing V and C flags, TST and TSTB have incorrect logic (setting Z=negative instead of Z=zero). Need to fix flag calculations to match PDP-11 specification.

title: Implement RK disk controller functionality
description: RK disk controller is currently stubbed with todo!() markers. Need to implement disk I/O functionality for reading disk images and handling RK11 disk controller registers and commands.

title: Implement Add trait for Word type
description: Currently Word has AddAssign but not Add. Implement ops::Add for Word to allow direct addition (a + b) instead of only add-assign (a += b). This will make arithmetic operations more ergonomic and follow Rust conventions.
